title: Bounded log rotation without data loss
prompt: An on-call service rotates a text log before appending a new line. When max_bytes is exceeded, current rotation overwrites the newest archive and loses older lines. Fix append_log(path, line, max_bytes, backups) in logging_store.py. Archive .1 is newest, keep up to backups archives, do not rotate for an empty log, and reject invalid size/backup limits. Run visible tests and validate.
